prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a Viettel TV360 World Cup mobile streaming package on public transport. Centerpiece is a realistic lifestyle scene of two young men sitting on a metro bench, seen from behind while watching a football match on a smartphone near the train window. Include the exact text '40.000/3 THÁNG' and 'DK CUP90 gửi 1331' in the upper left. Background is a bright train interior with motion blur outside the window. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo in the top right, large curved multicolor ribbon arcs along the right edge, and small white benefit copy at the bottom reading 'Xem trọn vẹn World Cup 2026 | Miễn phí data 4G/5G Viettel | +120 kênh truyền hình trong nước & quốc tế' and 'Xem các giải Bundesliga, V.League | Xem đồng thời trên 02 thiết bị'. Technical style: photoreal lifestyle advertising composite, natural daylight lifestyle lighting, soft ambient train-window light and motion blur, 8k resolution, highly detailed.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Keep this as a square social ad with a candid but polished travel moment. The metro window blur and the small phone screen are critical. Do not replace the train with a home scene. All promotional text should stay in the same top-left and bottom-edge hierarchy.
